name: fengshui-reasoning
title_zh: 命盘先过证据关再谈合婚的看宅师
tagline_zh: 八字合宅报告前，先让程序算盘与住宅过一遍证据链。不信口断吉凶，每条结论都标出处，装完你也是半个明理派。
tagline_en: Before writing a compatibility report, it cross-checks the program-calculated BaZi chart against the residence.
desc_en: Produce an evidence-bounded professional assessment of compatibility between a program-calculated BaZi chart and one residence before report writing.
why_zh: 把玄学判断拆成可核验的推理步骤，程序算盘与住宅参数逐项比对后才落笔，堵住江湖术士式拍脑袋结论。
why_en: Turns metaphysical judgment into checkable reasoning steps: chart and dwelling data must align before any conclusion. Kills the.
limit_zh: 只覆盖八字与住宅的合盘推理，不含择日、流年、飞星。需自备程序生成的八字盘与住宅方位数据，报告只出到推理结论。
limit_en: Only covers BaZi-residence fit reasoning, no date selection, annual stars, or flying stars. Needs your own chart & dwelling data; outputs.
title_en: BaZi-residence fit checker that demands evidence first
